Interactive AI coding chatbot for developer support.

Collaborative Coding Environment: Allows multiple users to code together in real-time. Audio and Video Communication: Facilitates discussions among collaborators. Support for Multiple Languages: Enables coding in over 10 different programming languages. Shared Code Execution: Users can execute code within the shared environment.
